properties.speechText:
From Monday 18 May until further notice, weekly from Sunday to Thursday, between 10pm and 5am, ceiling installation works will take place in the pedestrian tunnel between platforms 4 and 11 and the lower concourse.

 - During this time, the Redfern end stairs on Platforms 4 to 11 will be closed.
 - Customer will need to use the City end of the platform to exit via the Grand Concourse.
 - If you need assistance, ask station staff or call 9379 1777.

properties.smsText: Opal can be used between Bathurst and Lithgow Stations when booked
properties.speechText: If travelling by Coach to or from Bathurst you can use your Opal card or contactless card or device to tap on or off at Bathurst station and your origin/destination station provided the origin/destination is an Opal enabled station. When using Opal you will need to reserve a seat, at no cost, through the Contact Centre by calling 13 22 32 (Between 07:00 to 22:00 each day).
